'''Greeley''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Greeley served aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] and was aboard it in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] when the barge broke down while en route to the [[detainment moon]] [[Gradient Seven]]. Greeley was selected to be part of a boarding party that was to travel from the ''Purge'' to a nearby abandoned [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], to search for spare parts to try and repair the barge with. The team was led by [[Jareth Sartoris]] and it made it's way onto the Star Destroyer through a docking shaft. They then split into two and Sartoris, Blandings, the [[Imperial Corrections Officer]]s [[Austin]] and [[Vesek]], and the engineer [[Blandings]] made their way to the Star Destroyer's maintenance level, where they found some parts. They then made their way back to the ''Purge'', but all of the party, apart from Sartoris, had contracted a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] while on the Star Destroyer and Greeley began to feel ill. He was admitted to the ''Purge''{{'s}} medical bay, where he died of the illness a short time later.
